scenes.text: This tutorial covers Batch Runner. Queue modules, projects, and settings for reproducible unattended execution.
Open Batch Runner from the Data and batch runs section. Add projects and assemble the ordered module sequence each project should run.
In the main configuration area, choose presets, dependencies, resource limits, resume behavior, logging, and failure policy.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. validate the batch plan, test one job, and then run the remaining queue overnight or unattended.
When the workflow finishes, every job has its own status, settings snapshot, logs, outputs, and resumable run record.
